motionContract: No tooth modifiers/basis transforms; each object parented to its declared jaw. Each jaw has one valid fixed-X angle driver from MouthControl.open, no control action.
scope: Only all 496 repaired tooth-to-tooth pairs under the defined common rigid upper control and fixed-X lower hinge, with stated 5um numerical allowance. Original head neutral; a shared rigid head transform preserves nonintersection. Does not cover body/gingiva/tongue, facial morphs, other head deformations or runtime.
